source_records.json._retention_membership_rule: §4.9 CANONICAL-PATH PATTERN, applied 2026-08-15. Retention membership is materialised ONCE at `source_records.json -> candidates[].retained_evidence_membership`, referenced by everything and recomputed by nothing — the same discipline §4.9 fixes for `value_token_present`. Rationale: L1 never materialised `retained_evidence` (0 occurrences in the frozen sidecar); membership was derivable but not stored, so every consumer would otherwise re-derive it and the derivations could diverge. Minority relevance is retained (Part A §5.1: minority relevance is never excluded).

candidate_generation_policy_version.corroborating_source: Part A §3.1 'Multi-candidate provisioning': "Fixed, provisioned candidate set per parameter = the verified spans elicitation proposed for that parameter's targets... No new segmentation, ranking, or discovery." Read at Stage 1B; corroborates that no candidate-generation policy existed to be versioned.

_resolution_summary._one_root: BOTH nulls trace to the same constraint. `method` is null because completeness was never ESTABLISHED; `candidate_generation_policy_version` is null because candidates were never GENERATED. Both follow from Part B not measuring candidate-generation recall — the same constraint that makes §9.1 criterion #5 permanently unexercisable. THREE FINDINGS, ONE ROOT. A scope consequence, not three separate defects.
